metadata.description: Memory and governance for Claude Code sessions: K-mem (read-before-write gate, context resolver, tiered project notes, handoffs, docs checks) and DevFlow (the ticket tracker it uses).

plugins.name: k-mem
plugins.description: Read-before-write gate, context resolver with receipts, tiered project notes, handoffs between sessions, and docs checks that fail when the record and the tree disagree.

plugins.name: devflow
plugins.description: Solo ticket tracker for AI coding agents: projects, tickets with a mandatory why, dependencies, a verification gate, an ADR index, and a status report at session start.
